name: SubwaySense
tagline: Uses New York open data on ridership and incidents to help riders choose safer, less crowded subway trips.
problem: Subway riders face delays, crowding and safety worries.
solution: Combines state open data on ridership and police incident reports with AI to estimate safety and crowding for trips, in a mobile app.
demo_moment: Team-described: plan a trip and see safety and crowding for each option.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Found and used public open data to back the idea.

lessons: Search for public data first; it can turn a worry into a product.
